goal: Demo for taking work back: translate the apps monorepo's two top-level docs into Finnish as separate files, without touching any code. Keep every command, path, URL and code block exactly as it is; translate prose only. Use plain, natural Finnish (not word-for-word), and keep technical terms that Finnish developers use in English (Dokku, VPS, TLS, wildcard, proxy, vhost) with Finnish inflection where needed. Each ticket must leave the repository in a state the user can merge as is.

tickets.title: README.fi.md: translate README.md
tickets.spec: Create README.fi.md next to README.md with a faithful Finnish translation of the whole file (it is short: the Certs section about the wildcard TLS certificate, acme.sh and the three npm scripts). Keep the heading structure; keep the code block and every command verbatim; keep the link to scripts/TLS.md pointing at the same file. Then add one line to README.md directly under the top heading: 'Suomeksi: [README.fi.md](README.fi.md)'. Do not change anything else in README.md.
acceptance: README.fi.md exists and covers every paragraph of README.md
Code blocks, commands, paths and URLs are byte-identical to the English
README.md gained exactly one new line, the link to README.fi.md

tickets.title: DOCKER_SETUP.fi.md: translate DOCKER_SETUP.md
tickets.spec: Read README.fi.md first and reuse its terminology. Create DOCKER_SETUP.fi.md with a Finnish translation of DOCKER_SETUP.md: same headings and numbered steps, every command, environment variable name and code block verbatim. Add one line under the top heading of DOCKER_SETUP.md: 'Suomeksi: [DOCKER_SETUP.fi.md](DOCKER_SETUP.fi.md)'. Nothing else in DOCKER_SETUP.md changes.
acceptance: DOCKER_SETUP.fi.md exists and covers every section and step of the English file
Commands and variable names are unchanged
DOCKER_SETUP.md gained exactly one new line
Terminology matches README.fi.md (same Finnish word for the same English term)

tickets.title: Sanasto: glossary and consistency pass over both Finnish files
tickets.spec: Read README.fi.md and DOCKER_SETUP.fi.md side by side with their English originals. Fix any inconsistency in how the same English term was translated, and any sentence that reads as a word-for-word calque. Then append a section '## Sanasto' to the end of README.fi.md: a two-column Markdown table (Englanniksi | Suomeksi) with the 8 to 12 technical terms that appear in the two files and the Finnish form used, so the next translator follows the same choices. Do not touch the English files.
acceptance: README.fi.md ends with a '## Sanasto' table of 8 to 12 rows
Every term in the table is used consistently in both Finnish files
